text: **dsh-provider-proxy**（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按提供商主机和模型 ID 配置的出站代理路由。它在 DSH 的 LLM 流水线中关联当前提供商与模型，并包装进程级 Undici dispatcher；同时在插件配置页和设置页提供路由编辑界面。主要功能包括按主机匹配请求、按模型精确或前缀匹配、选择继承系统代理/直连/自定义 HTTP(S) 代理，以及为匹配请求添加自定义请求头。适合需要让不同模型或服务走不同代理的 DSH 用户。无需 API 密钥；使用自定义代理时需自行提供代理地址。

**dsh-provider-proxy** (DSH Web plugin): route outbound requests through different proxies by provider host or model ID. It adds matching rules, direct or inherited routing, custom HTTP(S) proxies, request headers, and web settings pages. No API key is required; custom proxy use requires an address.

**dsh-provider-proxy** 的功能「按模型路由」：根据 LLM 请求的提供商和模型 ID 选择代理，可配置精确模型或前缀规则，并支持提供商限定。模型请求以外的流量不会仅因模型规则而匹配。
**dsh-provider-proxy** 的功能「按主机路由」：根据出站请求的目标主机匹配提供商规则，为命中的请求选择继承系统代理、直连或自定义 HTTP(S) 代理。未命中时继续使用已有 dispatcher。
**dsh-provider-proxy** 的功能「请求头注入」：为匹配的代理规则添加配置的 HTTP 请求头；值中的 {{opencodeSession}} 会在分发时替换为新生成的会话格式 ID。
**dsh-provider-proxy** 的功能「网页路由配置」：在插件管理配置页和独立设置区域编辑默认路由、提供商主机规则及模型规则，表单保存时提交带版本的配置变更。
**dsh-provider-proxy** 的功能「应用状态记录」：插件将最近一次路由配置应用结果和路由摘要写入状态 JSON 文件，目录可由环境变量覆盖；写入失败不会阻止插件运行。

Per-provider and per-model outbound proxy routing for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

@apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy README · dsh-provider-proxy：DeepSeek Harness applies **one** proxy policy per process (`HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` / `NO_PROXY` / `ALL_PROXY`). This plugin layers two routing axes on top of it, configurable per provider host and per model ID — from a Plugins settings page, without touching YAML unless you want to. ```mermaid flowchart LR A["ctx.llm.stream
{provider, model}"] --> B["llm/stream waterfall
AsyncLocalStorage per pull"] B --> C["adapter → fetch"] C --> D["RoutingDispatcher"]

@apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy README · Install：Prerequisite: a DSH profile with a plugin manager (the Desktop app and `dsh web` both qualify).

**From npm** (recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy
```

**From git** (a release tag, no registry involved):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add git+https://github.com/apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy.git#v0.1.0
```

**From a local checkout:**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-provider-proxy

section: or: link the directory in the profile's package.json and run pnpm install there

text: @apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy README · In the UI (recommended)：Edits are staged locally and applied on **Save** with revision fencing: if someone changed the config meanwhile, the save is refused instead of silently overwriting. Clearing the form is never written; leaving the page drops staged edits.

@apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy README · In YAML：Add or edit the row in the profile’s `cordis.patch.yml` (HMR applies it live, no restart):

```yaml
- id: provider-proxy
  name: "dsh-provider-proxy"
  config:
    default: inherit

An invalid entry refuses the whole configuration (fail-closed): the plugin logs the reason, keeps the previous routes, and never partially applies them.

@apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy README · Injected headers：A rule can add headers to the requests it matches. The token `{{opencodeSession}}` becomes a fresh OpenCode-shaped session id (`ses_…`) on every dispatch — useful for anonymous gateways that demand a per-conversation header the model adapter does not send for hand-declared models:

```yaml
    models:
      "beam-free":
        provider: opencode-go
        proxy: "http://127.0.0.1:1301"

@apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy README · Proxy values：| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `inherit` | Use the launcher’s process proxy policy (env + `NO_PROXY`). |
| `direct` | Connect to the origin directly, ignoring the process proxy policy. |
| `http(s)://…` | Route through that proxy (`ProxyAgent`). SOCKS and PAC are rejected. |

The UI additionally refuses proxy URLs with embedded credentials — keep secrets out of the profile patch.

@apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy README · Muse Spark example：Route one model through its own proxy while everything else follows the launcher policy:

```yaml
- id: provider-proxy
  name: "dsh-provider-proxy"
  config:
    default: inherit

See [`examples/models-muse-spark.yaml`](./examples/models-muse-spark.yaml) (sanitized: loopback endpoints, no credentials). The same rule can be created in the Plugins page — the walkthrough is captured with [`assets/scripts/record-proxy-ui.sh`](./assets/scripts/record-proxy-ui.sh) into [`assets/gifs`](./assets/gifs/).

@apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy README · Verify it works：The plugin writes its last apply outcome (never secrets) to `$DSH_HOME/provider-proxy/state.json`:

```json
{
  "appliedAt": "2026-10-22T07:59:22Z",
  "pid": 42120,
  "status": "active",

A live rule can be proven by pointing it at a dead proxy (`http://127.0.0.1:9`) and watching the request fail with `ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:9` instead of reaching its target — then restore the real proxy.

@apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy README · Limits：- WebSocket transports are not guaranteed to pass through the undici dispatcher; use an `http`/`https` transport for strict routing.
- `web_fetch` pins validated addresses through the launcher's own policy and may bypass these routes; model traffic is covered.
- Model rules apply only inside `llm/stream`; web search and MCP use the host axis.
- A model rule never fires for non-model traffic that happens to hit the same host, and a host rule never overrides `localhost` / loopback.
- Proxy URLs with credentials are accepted by the transport but rejected by the UI; prefer credential-free proxy endpoints.

@apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy README · Walkthrough：Recorded in a scratch profile with a loopback proxy: open the bundle’s Configure page, add the Muse Spark model rule, trigger and fix a validation error, save.
